text:
Rafael: Heads up — proposing a lightweight "Weighted Composite Gate" for the int4 bring-up experiment. Idea: collapse a few noisy signals into a single score we can threshold for fractional promotions. Will paste the sketch below.

Aisha: +1 to formalizing. can you share the exact formula and the decision window?

Rafael: Sure. Rough pseudo:
```
# composite (lower is better)
composite = 0.6 * normalized_delta_top1 + 0.25 * hallucination_rate + 0.15 * normalized_latency95
# promote when composite <= 0.02 for rolling 60m with min_samples=1000
# auto-fallback if composite > 0.05 OR hallucination_rate_delta > 0.02 OR latency95_ratio > 1.25 for 10m
```
Notes: normalized_delta_top1 = (new - baseline)/baseline on our top-queries slice; normalized_latency95 = (latency95_new/latency95_baseline) - 1.

Jonas: Couple Qs — are weights fixed? sounds like we'd want slice-aware weights (safety slices heavier). Also need to tie this into the routing policy so fractional traffic steps respect sample counts.

Maya: Agree on slice-aware. Also we should cap the sensitivity early: small-sample noise can trigger a false positive. Suggest add an adaptive smoothing window: min_samples_per_slice=500 and exponential decay smoothing on the metric.

Rafael: Good call. Updated sketch:
```
weights = {"core": 0.6, "safety": 0.8}  # safety slices count more towards composite
min_samples_per_slice = 500
smoothing_alpha = 0.2  # EWMA smoothing for 1m granularity
rolling_window = 60m
promote_policy: require every traffic slice to meet composite <= threshold for 60m with min_samples satisfied
```

Sanjay: We'll need alerts wired to the Console. If auto-fallback triggers, create an incident marker and link to runbook. I can add a small webhook that creates an ops note.

SRE-Bot: Canary deployment started: model=v2-int4, traffic=0.5%, route=prod-chat, canary_id=cc-2582. Checks: smoke ok, mem < 85%.

Aisha: For scoring we rely on the eval harness (rerank accuracy + halluc detection). Who owns the eval set freshness? We need to ensure baseline is locked to the pinned production model at the time of rollout.

Rafael: Baseline snapshot will be created automatically at the start of the canary run (hash pinned). Eval harness will run rolling samplers against the live traffic slice and the shadow stream.

Jonas: Suggestion — add a secondary gate for resource regressions: if p95 GPU mem or p99 latency increases > 1.2x, block further ramp until manually ack. Keeps cost regressions out.

Maya: Also let's run a paired shadow test for the first 24h at 100% shadow to collect per-customer drift metrics (embedding similarity, answer divergence). That gives us a richer signal than top-queries alone.

Rafael: Agreed. Plan: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 25% with 30m dwell per step, composite gating and shadow collection throughout. Auto-fallback can instantly revert routing to previous pinned model and open an incident if thresholds hit.

Aisha: Can you add the config snippet to the PR? would like to review the exact thresholds.

Rafael: Will open PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234 (adds weighted_gate config + smoke checks). Please review & add comments.

Sanjay: I'll wire the console alerts to that PR. If we trigger auto-fallback, include the composite score time-series in the incident payload.

Maya: One more: let's tag experiments with `quant-int4-pilot-2582` so we can query logs and cost metrics easily.

Rafael: Done — tagging convention added to PR. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
